audience: agencies and site owners who host WordPress, Laravel or Magento apps on Cloudways servers

useCases.title: Check server status and usage
useCases.text: List your servers with their status and region. Read the bandwidth, or the disk size per application, of one server.

useCases.title: Read app traffic and logs
useCases.text: Read the traffic of an app by top URLs, IPs, bots or status codes. Read its recent access or error log lines.

useCases.title: Check app vulnerabilities and cron jobs
useCases.text: List the known vulnerabilities of an app from the Cloudways security scan. List the cron jobs of an app on its server.

useCases.title: Review billing and invoices
useCases.text: Read the charges of the current month and the estimated amount due. List the invoices of the account, newest first.

useCases.title: Restart a server or clear an app cache
useCases.text: Restart a server, which takes its apps offline for a short time, then check the restart by its operation id. Clear the cache of one app.
